description: This image is a high-resolution satellite photograph depicting a coastal environment. The lower portion of the image shows a body of teal-coloured water, likely a sea or large lake. Adjacent to the water is a strip of light-coloured sandy beach, extending horizontally across the image. Several elongated, dark structures, identified as groynes, extend perpendicularly from the beach into the water. A small, circular green marker with a white symbol is positioned on the sandy beach in the central-left area. Inland from the beach, the majority of the land area is covered by dense, dark green forest or woodland. Within and bordering this forested area, particularly in the upper-left quadrant, scattered light-coloured patches indicate the presence of artificial structures, buildings, and possibly open clearings or agricultural plots. Tracks or narrow roads are also visible meandering through the forested landscape.
